meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan in Codex with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Codex 中按计划自动执行多步骤工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Codex 中按计划自动执行多步骤工作流并支持中断恢复。
copy.tagline_en: Automate multi-step workflows in Codex from a plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically execute multi-step workflows in Codex from a plan with resume support.

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求执行工作计划时，Claude 不会自己写代码或改文件，而是把每个任务都分给专门的子代理去完成。它会先选好计划、更新状态，然后让多个子代理同时干活，最后检查结果并记下来。
howto.when: 当你说“开始工作”、“执行计划”、“继续计划”、“恢复计划”或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发。如果还没有计划，Claude 会引导你创建一个。

say.text: 开始执行 .omo/plans 里的优化计划。
say.note: Claude 会读取计划，分配子任务并行执行。

say.text: 继续我之前暂停的工作计划。
say.note: Claude 会恢复上次未完成的计划，从断点继续。

howto.what_en: When you ask to execute a work plan, Claude does not write code or edit files itself. Instead, it delegates every task to specialized sub-agents. It selects the plan, updates state, dispatches multiple parallel sub-tasks, then verifies and records evidence for each checkbox.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "start work", "execute plan", "continue plan", "resume plan", or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans. If no plan exists, Claude guides you to create one.

say_en.text: Start executing the optimization plan in .omo/plans.
say_en.note: Claude reads the plan, spawns sub-agents for each task.
Claude continues from the last uncompleted checkbox.
